candidates.defline: The Artisan stands at your Year Gate: ease and charm are the first things your story shows.
candidates.reading: This position rules Social and Health. You arrived with a light touch: a childhood face that put people at ease, a family style that valued good food, good humor, or good craft. Wellbeing is your inheritance, and it shows in how naturally you host, soothe, and enjoy. The shadow is softness: a start this comfortable can under-build ambition. Keep the warmth, it is real wealth. Just give it something worth making.
